text:
pranav: Heads-up — noticed some customers getting billed for 'fncall_reject' on degen routes.
billing-bot: Invoice alert: charge event recorded for acct acme-corp — event_type=fncall_reject route=degen route_id=degen-02 cost_units=1
jen: Wait, fncall_reject should be non-billable when it’s a schema fallback (we fallback to degen) — that's how we agreed in the pricing doc.
sam: I just pulled logs. Example payload:
```
ERROR: validator.reject -> { "route":"degen-02","reason":"invalid_tool_shape","decision":"reject","billing":true }
```
maya: That 'billing' flag being true is the bug. Validator never sets billing; the core router does when it maps decision->billing. Somewhere we're conflating reject_origin=validator vs reject_origin=policy
linda: cc @pranav @jen — a concrete repro is in trace 2026-03-18T14:02:23Z: validator returned REJECT+sample=true but router applied charge because sampling tag missing.
pranav: Proposal: add structured field `reject_metadata.origin` and `reject_metadata.sampled=false|true` and ensure billing only for origin=policy AND sampled=true. Also add debug tag for console: 'reject_insight' to group these in dashboard without counting as billable.
jen: Sounds reasonable. We should also backfill recent events and mark them as non-billable for accounting.
sam: UI side — Console needs a new column 'Reject origin' and a filter 'exclude non-billable schema rejects' so CS can triage.
maya: Telemetry: we should emit metric `rejects.schema.nonbillable` with route tag so we can track noise.
billing-bot: NOTE: Interim patch applied to router v2.3.1: if reject_metadata.origin=="validator" then billing=false (hotfix).
linda: Can we add a regression test? unit + e2e for validator->router handoff ensuring billing flag false for validator rejects.
pranav: I'll open a PR for the schema (Validator->Router contract) and a console dashboard ticket. Anyone want to co-own sampling/backfill? :hand:
jen: I'll take sampling/backfill. Will sync with finance.
sam: I can do the console UX for the filter, ETA EOD tomorrow.
maya: I'll own telemetry + test coverage.
pranav: Great — filing issues in GH and adding to the canary checklist. Thanks all :thumbsup:
